scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --minify --format=esm --outfile=dist/city.js && cp index.html dist/index.html && mkdir -p dist/modelos dist/sprites && cp -R assets/modelos/. dist/modelos/ && cp -R assets/sprites/. dist/sprites/ && python3 sella.py && esbuild src/hall.ts --bundle --minify --format=esm --outfile=dist-hall/hall.js
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --strict --target es2022 --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler --skipLibCheck src/main.ts src/oven.ts src/hall.ts
